Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

BuildProjectFile.description: Path to the build project (.csproj) relative to the repository root. Defaults to 'build/_build.csproj' when unset. Read by the Fallout global tool's in-tool runner.

AppName.description: Runnable app name to execute (any src/** project with OutputType=Exe)

AppNames.description: Runnable app names to execute in parallel (comma-separated)

ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT.description: Environment the build is running in (typically configured by environment variable)

AutoStageLintFixes.description: Re-stage lint fixes only in previously staged files without unstaged changes

Configuration.description: Configuration to build - (Debug or Release; defaults to Release)

DependencyInstallTool.description: Allow installing or reinstalling dotnet-outdated without prompting

DependencyMapOutput.description: Where GenerateDependencyMap writes the HTML page; defaults to docs/dependency-map.html

DependencyVersionLock.description: Dependency version lock: Major, Minor or None

DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT.description: Environment the build is running in (typically configured by environment variable)

HookSkipLintFix.description: Omit lint fixing from the hook

HookSkipTestRuntime.description: Omit integration and end-to-end tests from the hook

HookSkipTestStatic.description: Omit lint and unit tests from the hook

HookType.description: Git hook type (default: pre-commit for enable/disable, all for show)

IsCiBuild.description: Indicates whether the build runs on CI

LayeringByFolder.description: Determine project layers from folders under the layering root instead of project name prefixes

LayeringRoot.description: Root folder for layering checks, relative to the solution (defaults to src)

NuGetApiKey.description: API key for the NuGet feed (optional when using configured credentials)

NuGetSource.description: NuGet feed URL or local directory to push packages to

ReleaseBase.description: Git commit or ref to compare package versions against

ReleaseBump.description: Semantic version increment: major, minor or patch

ReleaseHead.description: Git commit or ref for head of changes (defaults to HEAD)

ReleaseProject.description: Project name to release (for example Core.Events)

ResetAppSettings.description: Asks again for every appsettings.json.template key, offering the current value as the default

SkipDuplicate.description: Skip package versions already present on the feed

Solution.description: Path to a solution file that is automatically loaded
